name: claude-code-bridge
description: Run local Claude Code from deterministic Codex commands, with guarded MCP fallback and a multi-image clipboard queue.

interface.longDescription: A local bridge that intercepts explicit /claude commands before the Codex model, invokes an already-installed Claude Code CLI, queues multiple Windows clipboard images without manual saving, controls models and permissions, and keeps an MCP/Skill fallback for model-directed use.
